name: Acorn 20/20
review_note: Independent Kingston Council records identify Acorn 20 at 20 Richmond Road, Kingston upon Thames, KT2 5BE. The source address omitted Kingston/postcode, causing the geocoder to resolve a different 20 Richmond Road in Leytonstone.

review_note: Independent references place Corrib Rest at 76-78 Salusbury Road, Queen's Park, NW6 6PA. CAMRA's sat-nav reference is about 73 m from the dataset coordinate, strongly supporting the coordinate and identifying the address spelling as the defect.
